name: Mrk 1034 (Hubble)
blurb: Mrk 1034, a pair of spiral galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: mrk1034-hubble
story: Two spiral galaxies seen face-on, close enough to be bound together by gravity and probably only just beginning to interact. After maybe hundreds of millions of years, they will merge into one.

claims.text: The pair is PGC 9074 (Sa) and PGC 9071 (Sb), two spiral galaxies
They are close enough to be bound together by gravity
They are probably only just beginning to interact
After maybe hundreds of millions of years they will merge
